name: vedett-route-accessibility-sidecar
description: Vedett Utvonal - VPS accessibility lookup sidecar (Task C3). Small, framework-free Node process: serves the accessibility index built from the canonical BKK GTFS zip as a server-to-server lookup for the Next.js server, so it never downloads/parses the full GTFS per request.

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:test
